presentation.title: E-commerce platform — Dimentionalizer
presentation.headline: E-commerce platform.
presentation.description: A storefront with catalog, cart, checkout, external payment processing, and asynchronous fulfillment. Service boundaries are illustrative and can be consolidated.

objects.name: Shopper browser
objects.description: The customer-facing browser for product discovery and checkout.

objects.name: Storefront CDN
objects.description: Delivers storefront assets and product images close to shoppers.

objects.name: Storefront application
objects.description: Renders the shopping experience and calls commerce APIs.

objects.name: Commerce gateway
objects.description: Routes API requests to catalog, cart, and checkout services.

objects.name: Product catalog
objects.description: Serves product descriptions, availability views, and prices.

objects.name: Cart service
objects.description: Maintains active shopping baskets and recalculates their display totals.

objects.name: Checkout service
objects.description: Validates the order, coordinates payment, and persists an order before fulfillment.

objects.name: Product database
objects.description: Stores product and inventory reference records.

objects.name: Order database
objects.description: Stores order status, payment references, and an outbox for reliable publication.

objects.name: Cart cache
objects.description: Holds short-lived baskets. Recovery and retention policy depend on the actual product.

objects.name: Product media
objects.description: Origin storage for product images and static assets.

objects.name: Payment provider
objects.description: External payment processor. The preset includes API calls and callback direction, not payment implementation.

objects.name: Outbox publisher
objects.description: Publishes committed order events from the outbox; consumers must handle redelivery.

objects.name: Order queue
objects.description: Buffers accepted orders for downstream fulfillment.

objects.name: Fulfillment worker
objects.description: Consumes order work, coordinates shipment, and records progress.
